library.question: what are the library hours?
library.answer: The library is open from 8 AM to 5 PM on weekdays and 10 AM to 2 PM on weekends.

library.question: can I borrow books during holidays?
library.answer: Yes, with prior permission from the librarian.

library.question: how do I renew a borrowed book?
library.answer: You can renew a book through the library portal or at the library counter.

library.question: Are there any fines for overdue books?
library.answer: Yes, students must return library books before exams and may face penalties for overdue items. A 'no dues' certificate is required to sit for exams.

library.question: Where is library located in RIT?
library.answer: The library is located in the Institutional building on the campus.

library.question: How many books can a student borrow at a time in library?
library.answer: Students can borrow a maximum of three books at a time.

library.question: Can I reserve a book that is currently issued to someone else?
library.answer: You can reserve a book at RIT Chennai library by searching the online catalog and clicking 'Request.' The library will notify you when it's available for pickup.

fees.question: when is the fees deadline?
fees.answer: Fees must be paid by April 30th.

fees.question: how can I pay tuition online?
fees.answer: You can pay tuition fees through the student portal using UPI, debit card, or net banking.

fees.question: can I pay my fees in installments?
fees.answer: Yes, installment options are available for eligible students. Contact the accounts office.

fees.question: Where can I check my fee receipt or dues?
fees.answer: You can check your fee receipt or any outstanding dues in the Accounts Room located in the Green Building.

fees.question: Where can I get help understanding my tuition or fees?
fees.answer: You can visit the student services or accounts office on campus for personalized guidance.

fees.question: Are students from economically weaker sections eligible for special fee waivers?
fees.answer: Yes, students from economically weaker sections (EWS) may be eligible for special fee waivers.

fees.question: Can students apply for multiple financial aid schemes?
fees.answer: Yes, students can apply for multiple financial aid schemes simultaneously.

fees.question: Who do I contact if the online payment failed but the amount was deducted?
fees.answer: Contact your bank to confirm the transaction and initiate a reversal, then verify with the accounts section if they received the payment and provide proof.

fees.question: Are exam fees refunded if I miss the exam for medical reasons?
fees.answer: Exam fees are usually non-refundable for medical absences, but the college may offer partial refunds or rescheduling.

fees.question: What should I do if my fee receipt has incorrect details?
fees.answer: If your fee receipt has errors, contact the accounts department with payment proof to fix it.

fees.question: Is there an EMI or installment option for paying fees?
fees.answer: Yes, there are options for EMI or installment plans for paying fees at RIT.

fees.question: What is the tuition fee structure for each academic year?
fees.answer: The tuition fees at RIT Chennai range from INR 55,000 to 66,000 for B.E./B.Tech programs and INR 50,000 to 55,000 for M.E./M.Tech in the first year.

hostel.question: what is the hostel curfew time?
hostel.answer: Hostel curfew is 10 PM every day.

hostel.question: can parents visit students in hostel?
hostel.answer: Yes, parents can visit during designated hours with prior permission.

hostel.question: how do I report a maintenance issue in hostel?
hostel.answer: You can report maintenance issues through the hostel portal or directly to the warden.

hostel.question: Is it possible to vacate the hostel during the semester seasons?
hostel.answer: Hostel vacating during exams is allowed with prior permission in exceptional circumstances, with a written request endorsed by relevant authorities.

hostel.question: What are the meal timings in hostel?
hostel.answer: Meal timings are as follows: Breakfast – 6:00 to 8:00 AM, Lunch – 11:30 AM to 1:30 PM and Dinner – 7:00 to 8:00 PM.

hostel.question: Where is the hostel located?
hostel.answer: RIT has separate hostels for boys and girls. Girls hostel is located on the campus itself and boys hostel is located in IMA Chennai.

hostel.question: What are the hostel fees for the current academic year?
hostel.answer: Hostel fee is somewhere around 60,000-75,000 annually.

hostel.question: How many students are accommodated in a single hostel room?
hostel.answer: Most hostel rooms at RIT accommodate 2-4 students.

hostel.question: How can I apply for hostel accommodation?
hostel.answer: To apply for hostel accommodation fill out the online application with personal and academic details, and pay the required fee.

hostel.question: Is there a laundry facility available in the hostel?
hostel.answer: Yes, the college hostel provides laundry facility available in the hostel.

hostel.question: What amenities are provided in the hostel rooms?
hostel.answer: Amenities in Hostel rooms include basic furniture like a cot, cupboard, and study table. Some rooms have a bookshelf, pest repellent light, and ceiling fan.

hostel.question: Is Wi-Fi available in the hostel premises?
hostel.answer: Yes, Wi-Fi is available in the hostel premises 24/7.

hostel.question: Can students suggest changes to the mess menu?
hostel.answer: Yes, students can suggest changes to the mess menu! Your feedback helps improve the dining experience for everyone.

hostel.question: Is outside food delivery allowed in the hostel?
hostel.answer: Outside food delivery is allowed in the hostel only on weekends.

hostel.question: What’s the procedure if I want to shift from day scholar to hostel student mid-semester?
hostel.answer: To switch from day scholar to hostel mid-semester submit an application, surrender your day scholar ID, pay the fees, and wait for room availability confirmation.

hostel.question: Are students allowed to cook food in hostel rooms?
hostel.answer: No students are not permitted to cook food inside hostel .

hostel.question: Are hostel students allowed to go out on weekends?
hostel.answer: Yes, hostel students can go out on weekends, but must return by the curfew time, usually 6-7 PM.

hostel.question: Is medical assistance available for 24/7 in the hostel in case of emergencies?
hostel.answer: Yes, medical assistance is available 24/7 in the hostel in case of emergencies.

hostel.question: Can students organize group events or celebrations inside the hostel?
hostel.answer: Yes, students can organize events in the hostel with prior permission from the head of the institution and by following guidelines.

hostel.question: Is prior permission required for staying outside the hostel overnight?
hostel.answer: Yes, prior permission from the reputed warden is required to stay outside the hostel overnight.

hostel.question: Is there a dress code inside the hostel premises?
hostel.answer: No, there is no dress code inside the hostel premises.

hostel.question: Can parents or guardians stay overnight in the hostel?
hostel.answer: No, parents or guardians are not allowed to stay overnight in the hostel.

hostel.question: Can I change my room or block after allotment in hostel?
hostel.answer: Yes, you can change your room or block after allotment, but prior permission from the reputed warden is required.

hostel.question: Will I be charged if there is damage to hostel property?
hostel.answer: Yes, you will likely be charged for any damage to hostel property.

hostel.question: Can hostel students access sports facilities after 6 PM?
hostel.answer: Yes, hostel students at RIT can typically access sports facilities after 6 PM.

academics.question: where can I check my exam schedule?
academics.answer: Exam schedules are published on the student portal under 'Academics > Exam Timetable'.

academics.question: how do I register for elective courses?
academics.answer: Elective registration opens during the first week of each semester on the portal.

academics.question: what is the minimum attendance requirement?
academics.answer: A minimum of 75% attendance is mandatory to sit for semester exams.

academics.question: How many internal and external exams are there per semester?
academics.answer: In a typical semester at RIT, there are three Internal Assessment Tests (CAT-I, CAT-II, CAT-III), one Model Exam, and one End Semester Exam.

academics.question: Where and when do I collect my exam hall ticket?
academics.answer: RIT distributes exam hall tickets through the Exam Cell, and they are handed over to students by the class in-charges a few days before the exams.

academics.question: What should I do if there's an error on my hall ticket?
academics.answer: First, contact the exam officials or department handling hall tickets for guidance on corrections or replacements.

academics.question: Can I appear for the exam without an ID card or hall ticket?
academics.answer: No, students are not permitted to appear for the exam without an ID card or hall ticket.

academics.question: Are internal assessments mandatory for all subjects?
academics.answer: Yes, internal assessments at RIT are mandatory and count for 20% of the course grade, while end semester exams carry 80%.

academics.question: Are there scholarships I can apply for during the year?
academics.answer: Yes, the college offers merit- and category-based scholarships year-round for both UG and PG students.

academics.question: When are the semester exams usually held?
academics.answer: Semester exams at RIT are generally held in November/December for the odd semester and April/May for the even semester.

academics.question: How long does it take for the semester results to be announced?
academics.answer: The results are typically announced within a few weeks (3-4 weeks) after the end of the semester.

academics.question: How can I contact my academic advisor?
academics.answer: To contact your academic advisor you can typically reach them via email or during their office hours.

academics.question: What is the procedure to apply for a re-examination in case of absence on the exam date?
academics.answer: Re-examination is possible for absentees; contact the Head of Department and follow the required procedures.

academics.question: Are resume reviews or mock interviews available?
academics.answer: Yes, the college offers resume reviews and mock interviews as part of their Training and Placement Cell activities.

academics.question: What are the consequences of cheating or using unfair means?
academics.answer: Cheating or using unfair means can lead to serious academic consequences, including failing grades, suspension, or even expulsion.

academics.question: What items are allowed inside the exam hall?
academics.answer: Students are typically allowed to bring their admit card, essential stationery, transparent water bottle, and a non-digital watch.

academics.question: How are practical exams evaluated?
academics.answer: Practical exams are assessed via internal tests, model exams, end-semester exams, and emphasized viva sessions.

academics.question: Is there an option for re-evaluation or rechecking of answer scripts?
academics.answer: Yes, RIT offers a re-evaluation (or rechecking) process for answer scripts.

academics.question: How do I apply for revaluation?
academics.answer: Students must submit a filled application with a fee of Rs. 500 per script to the COE office. Revaluation is allowed for up to 3 answer scripts.

academics.question: How many attempts do I get to clear a backlog?
academics.answer: Students typically get multiple opportunities to clear backlogs.

academics.question: Can I still write the exam if I have a medical issue affecting attendance?
academics.answer: Yes, you may be allowed to write the exam with a valid medical reason. Submit a medical certificate and inform the HoD or administration. Send a formal request to the Principal or Dean. Approval depends on the case.

academics.question: What support is available for students with disabilities or special needs during exams?
academics.answer: The institution provides support for students with disabilities or special needs during exams, including barrier-free environment and accessible features.

academics.question: What is the usual duration and format of a viva?
academics.answer: Viva sessions are part of lab and project evaluations. Duration varies by course, and project vivas are usually conducted by internal and external examiners.

academics.question: Will I receive a backlog if I fail the laboratory component of that particular subject?
academics.answer: Yes, failing the laboratory component of a subject can indeed lead to a backlog for that subject. While the internal marks remain unchanged.

academics.question: What is the grading system followed at RIT?
academics.answer: RIT uses relative grading—‘O’ for 90%+, ‘B’ for ≥50%, with other grades curved in between.

academics.question: Are there mentorship programs for first-year students?
academics.answer: Yes, mentorship programs are conducted for first-year students after every semester.

academics.question: Is there a dress code for lab sessions?
academics.answer: The college enforces a dress code for lab sessions, requiring formal attire and a compulsory pair of shoes.

academics.question: Is there any breakage fee if I break any lab equipment?
academics.answer: Yes, you may need to pay a breakage fee.

academics.question: Is it mandatory to use only college-provided notes for exams?
academics.answer: No, it is not mandatory to use only college-provided notes for exams. While the college may provide notes as a resource, students are free to utilize other study materials, including their own handwritten notes, textbooks, and other sources.

academics.question: Are digital notes shared through any platform or app?
academics.answer: Yes, digital notes are shared at the college through section- and department-specific WhatsApp groups created by the college.

academics.question: Are practical/lab manuals provided by the department?
academics.answer: Yes, practical and lab manuals are provided by the departments to support hands-on learning.

academics.question: How can I apply for lateral entry into the second year?
academics.answer: The application process usually involves registering online, submitting the required documents, and potentially participating in a merit-based screening.

academics.question: Who decides the internal exam schedule — department or institution?
academics.answer: The College Examination Committee is responsible for preparing the academic calendar and scheduling internal examinations.

academics.question: Will the college provide the necessary study materials for our subjects?
academics.answer: Yes, study materials, including textbooks and online resources are provided for their courses.

academics.question: Is smartwatches allowed during exams?
academics.answer: No smartwatches are prohibited during exams.

academics.question: How many department does the college offers?
academics.answer: RIT Chennai offers eight departments under its undergraduate engineering programs, including B.E. in Computer Science & Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer & Communication Engineering, Electronic Engineering (VLSI), and Bio Technology, and B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science and Computer Science and Business Systems.

Placement.question: What companies visit RIT for campus placements?
Placement.answer: Top companies like TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Amazon, IBM, Microsoft, and additionally companies like Zoho, Oracle, Huawei, South Indian Bank, and Envestnet also participate.

Placement.question: What is the average placement package offered?
Placement.answer: The average placement package at RIT Chennai is around ₹4–9LPA.

Placement.question: What is the highest and lowest placement package offered?
Placement.answer: The highest placement ranges from 25 to 45 LPA, while the lowest package is around 3.5 LPA.

Placement.question: Is there a placement cell in the college?
Placement.answer: Yes the college offers a placement cell. This cell plays a crucial role in helping students develop employability skills and find employment.

Placement.question: Are internships facilitated by the college?
Placement.answer: The college offers internships and practical training through collaborations with companies like TCS, Wipro, and Zoho.

Placement.question: What are the eligibility criteria for placement?
Placement.answer: The eligibility criteria for placements are that students must have completed a B.E./B.Tech and meet the Class 12 percentage criteria.

campus_life.question: is there a shuttle service available?
campus_life.answer: Yes, shuttle buses operate between main campus points from 7 AM to 9 PM.

campus_life.question: how do I join a campus club?
campus_life.answer: You can register for clubs during the student activities fair or online portal.

campus_life.question: is there a gym on campus?
campus_life.answer: Yes, the campus gym is open daily from 6 AM to 9 PM for all students.

campus_life.question: Does the college host any inter-college cultural fests or events?
campus_life.answer: Yes, RIT hosts inter-college cultural fests and events. YATRA is a grand intercollege cultural fest organized by the student community with the support of Faculties, Principal and authorities.

campus_life.question: Is permission available for birthday celebrations on campus?
campus_life.answer: No, permission is generally not granted for students to celebrate birthdays inside the campus.

campus_life.question: What kind of cultural or arts events happen on campus?
campus_life.answer: The college organizes a variety of cultural and arts events, including its annual cultural festival, Yatra, and events celebrated by the Artist League cultural club.

campus_life.question: How many events are usually conducted in the college each year?
campus_life.answer: RIT typically hosts over 50 sports, cultural activities, and competitions each year. These events include cultural festival, Yatra, and various departmental events.

campus_life.question: Are meal plans available, and how do they work?
campus_life.answer: Yes, RIT offers meal plans with a vegetarian canteen, subsidized mess (including a separate one for boys), and hostel dining halls.

campus_life.question: What kind of cultural or arts events happen on campus?
campus_life.answer: The college organizes a variety of cultural and arts events, including its annual cultural festival, Yatra, and events celebrated by the Artist League cultural club.

campus_life.question: Is non-vegetarian food available on campus?
campus_life.answer: Non-vegetarian food is not available on campus.

campus_life.question: Are there any food outlets or cafes within the campus?
campus_life.answer: The campus has a canteen with a variety of foods and desserts.

campus_life.question: Are there vending machines available on campus?
campus_life.answer: Yes, vending machines are available on campus, specifically in the Green Building.

campus_life.question: What student clubs are active on campus?
campus_life.answer: The active student clubs on campus include the STEAM Club, IoT Club, CAM Club, TechSparks Club, NSS club, Language Club, Maths Club, Rotaract Club, and YUVA Club.

campus_life.question: What is the procedure to join a club?
campus_life.answer: To join a college club, find one that interests you and fill out the application via email or provided links.

campus_life.question: Are there any leadership opportunities within clubs?
campus_life.answer: RIT offers leadership roles in clubs, including president, vice president, treasurer, and event committee positions.

campus_life.question: Do club members receive certificates for participation?
campus_life.answer: Yes, club members receive certificates in recognition of their active participation and contributions to club activities.

campus_life.question: Can clubs collaborate with industries or NGOs?
campus_life.answer: Yes, clubs can collaborate with industries and NGOs. The college actively fosters partnerships with industries.

campus_life.question: Are project exhibitions conducted by student clubs?
campus_life.answer: Yes, RIT does conduct project exhibitions by student clubs.

campus_life.question: Can club activities contribute to academic credits?
campus_life.answer: No, club activities do not typically contribute to academic credits.

campus_life.question: Do clubs have membership fees?
campus_life.answer: No, joining club doesn't require membership fees.

campus_life.question: Are there clubs focused on social service or volunteering?
campus_life.answer: Yes, RIT has Rotaract Club , YUVA club, UBA club, YRC club and an NSS (National Service Scheme) club.

campus_life.question: Will On Duty (OD) be granted if I participate in a club event?
campus_life.answer: Yes, official OD will be granted to students who have registered for the club events.

campus_life.question: Does the college have any coding or programming clubs?
campus_life.answer: Yes, there's the Techsparks Club which organizes events like 'BLIND CODING'.

campus_life.question: What types of clubs are available for students (technical, cultural, sports, etc.)?
campus_life.answer: The active student clubs on campus include the STEAM Club, YRC Club, UBA Club, TechSparks Club, NSS club, Tamil Club, Fusion club(english club), Infinitus Club, Rotaract Club, and YUVA Club.

campus_life.question: Are clubs open to all departments and years?
campus_life.answer: Yes, clubs are open to all the students from all departments and years.

general.question: how can I get my ID card reissued?
general.answer: Report the lost ID at the admin office and apply for reissuance with proper documents.

general.question: how do I update my contact number in records?
general.answer: You can update your contact number by logging into the student portal under profile settings.

general.question: how do I request for a transcript?
general.answer: You can request transcripts online through the academic portal or by visiting the academic office.

general.question: What is the college's email ID and contact number?
general.answer: College email ID - mail@ritchennai.edu.in; Contact numbers - 4467181600 or 8925977445.

general.question: How do I report a maintenance issue?
general.answer: To report maintenance issues, contact the college administration via phone, email, website, or Grievance Cell.

general.question: Is there a specific dress code to follow in college?
general.answer: Boys must wear tucked-in formal shirts, chinos/formal pants (no jeans), and formal shoes. Girls must wear salwar with dupatta; jeans, short tops, and T-shirts are not allowed.

general.question: How do I get a new ID card in case I lost the previous one?
general.answer: To get a new ID card, contact Student Affairs or the ID Card Office with your student ID and required details; a replacement fee may apply.

general.question: Is mobile phone usage allowed inside the classroom?
general.answer: Mobile phone use is strictly prohibited in classrooms, unless prior permission is given by the faculty.

general.question: How do I access Wi-Fi on campus?
general.answer:
You can access the internet from virtually anywhere on campus. To connect to the Wi-Fi:
1) Locate the network
2) Connect to the network
3) Log in

general.question: Are programming labs available after regular college hours?
general.answer: Programming labs can be used after regular hours with HOD approval and specific groups present.

general.question: Is it possible to leave college before the scheduled time in case of an emergency?
general.answer: Yes, it is possible but it requires proper information and approval from the administration.

general.question: What are the college opening hours?
general.answer: The Institution is typically open from 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM.

general.question: Can I bring a bike or scooter to campus?
general.answer: Yes, students can bring their own vehicles to campus. The college has parking facilities for both two-wheelers and cars.

general.question: Is there campus parking available for students?
general.answer: Yes, campus parking is available for students at RIT. It is located outside the main campus near the entrance.

general.question: What should I do if I lose my ID or hall ticket right before the exam?
general.answer: If you lose your ID or hall ticket before an exam, contact the administration office for help. You may get a temporary ID or duplicate hall ticket for a fee. Also, report the loss to the HOD.

general.question: What is the college's email ID?
general.answer: College email ID- mail@ritchennai.edu.in

general.question: What is the college's contact number?
general.answer: Contact number - 4467181600 or 8925977445

general.question: Are there mentorship programs for first-year students?
general.answer: Yes, mentorship programs are conducted for first-year students after every semester.

general.question: Can students pitch their own ideas for campus improvement or innovation?
general.answer: Yes, RIT Chennai allows students to pitch ideas through IIC and student councils.

general.question: Are there any bridge courses for students from non-technical backgrounds?
general.answer: Yes, mostly online bridge courses help non-tech students build basics in math, science, and communication.

general.question: Do the classrooms have air conditioning?
general.answer: Yes, classrooms at RIT are air-conditioned, offering a comfortable learning environment.

general.question: Are smart boards available in the classrooms?
general.answer: Yes, classrooms are equipped with smart boards, enhancing interactive and tech-enabled learning experiences.

general.question: Is there a water tank available for drinking water?
general.answer: Yes, drinking water tanks are available on every floor for student convenience.

general.question: Are there any printing shops on campus?
general.answer: Yes, there is a printing shop on campus, located opposite the admin office.

general.question: Are mobile phones allowed inside the lab?
general.answer: No, mobile phones are prohibited inside labs.

general.question: Are accessories like caps, sunglasses, or bandanas allowed on campus?
general.answer: Accessories like caps, sunglasses, and bandanas are likely not permitted on the campus.

general.question: Are students required to carry their ID cards at all times?
general.answer: Yes, students are generally required to carry their identity cards at all times while on campus.

general.question: Are there restrictions on using personal laptops in class?
general.answer: RIT doesn't explicitly ban laptops in classrooms, it does restrict the use of cell phones.

general.question: Is 24/7 medical assistance available on campus?
general.answer: Yes, 24/7 medical assistance is available on campus.

general.question: Does the college have notice boards in every block?
general.answer: Yes, the college has notice boards in every block.

transport.question: What are the bus routes for the college?
transport.answer: The college has multiple bus routes. For details, check the transport page - www.rittransport.com or contact the bus manager.

transport.question: What time do the buses arrive at the college?
transport.answer: College buses typically arrive at the campus before 8 AM.

transport.question: Is there a transportation fee separate from tuition?
transport.answer: Yes, rit does have a separate transportation fee for students utilizing the college's bus service.

transport.question: Is any safety kit provided in buses?
transport.answer: Yes, safety kits are provided on the buses.

transport.question: Is there a WhatsApp group or app for bus delay or cancellation updates?
transport.answer: Yes, WhatsApp groups are available to provide updates in case of any delays or cancellations.
